description: This file defines the 'GenericDateDisplayField' class, which extends 'CombinedDisplayField' and manages date display fields within the OrangeHRM reporting module, including mapping field aliases to entity attributes and providing related metadata.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayField
classes.description: Represents a date display field with specific mappings for Employee and Termination Date fields, extending combined display field functionalities.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets internal tags based on the provided display field object, mapping field aliases to entity attributes.

methods.name: setEntityAlias
methods.description: Sets the entity alias for the field.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the DTO class name associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array containing the entity alias used by this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array containing the field name used for display.
